structures.label: Flexor retinaculum
structures.description: Strong band across the front of the wrist forming the roof of the carpal tunnel.
structures.function: Keeps the finger flexor tendons in place; the median nerve runs beneath it.

structures.label: Extensor retinaculum
structures.description: Band across the back of the wrist dividing the extensor tendons into compartments.
structures.function: Stops the extensor tendons bowstringing when the wrist extends.

structures.label: Palmar aponeurosis
structures.description: Triangular sheet of tough tissue under the skin of the palm.
structures.function: Protects tendons and grips; it thickens in Dupuytren's disease.

structures.label: Thenar muscles
structures.description: Group of short thumb muscles forming the ball of the thumb.
structures.function: Move the thumb across the palm to pinch and grasp (opposition).

structures.label: Hypothenar muscles
structures.description: Group of muscles forming the fleshy edge of the palm below the little finger.
structures.function: Move the little finger and cup the palm.

structures.label: Adductor pollicis
structures.description: Deep fan-shaped muscle in the web between thumb and index.
structures.function: Pulls the thumb against the palm for a strong key grip.

structures.label: Lumbricals
structures.description: Four small worm-like muscles attached to the deep flexor tendons.
structures.function: Bend the knuckles while straightening the finger joints.

structures.label: Interossei
structures.description: Muscles between the metacarpal bones, on the back and front.

structures.label: Flexor digitorum superficialis
structures.description: Forearm muscle whose four tendons run through the carpal tunnel to the fingers.
structures.function: Bends the middle joints of the fingers and the wrist.

structures.label: Flexor digitorum profundus
structures.description: Deep forearm flexor whose tendons reach the fingertips.
structures.function: Bends the fingertip joints; essential for grip.

structures.label: Pronator quadratus
structures.description: Square muscle across the lower radius and ulna.
structures.function: Turns the palm down and holds the two forearm bones together.

structures.label: Wrist collateral ligaments
structures.description: Ligaments on the thumb and little-finger sides of the wrist.
structures.function: Limit side-to-side tilting of the wrist.

structures.label: Triangular fibrocartilage (disc)
structures.description: Cartilage disc on the little-finger side of the wrist.
structures.function: Cushions the ulna and stabilises forearm rotation; a common cause of ulnar wrist pain.

structures.label: Carpal bones
structures.description: Eight small bones in two rows forming the wrist.
structures.function: Give the wrist its flexibility and form the floor of the carpal tunnel.

structures.label: Metacarpals
structures.description: Five long bones of the palm.
structures.function: Form the palm and the knuckles.

structures.label: Phalanges
structures.description: Finger bones: three in each finger, two in the thumb.
structures.function: Allow the fingers to bend and grip.

structures.label: Radius (distal)
structures.description: Outer forearm bone; its wide lower end carries most of the wrist.
structures.function: Main bone of the wrist joint; the usual site of wrist fractures.

structures.label: Ulna (distal)
structures.description: Inner forearm bone, ending in the ulnar styloid.
structures.function: Pivot around which the radius turns.
